_howto: Master list of mentorship/advisory services. `prices` are display strings per currency (INR, USD, EUR, GBP). Currency is auto-selected from the visitor's country at the edge (see `geo`); there is NO manual switcher — each visitor only ever sees their local currency. `defaultCurrency` is used when the country isn't matched. Cards show `duration` · price (matching the Topmate style). `cta`: 'pay' → the Razorpay payment link for the detected currency (paymentLinks); 'enquire' → the intro-call/contact CTA. `detailSlug` is for the future dedicated page per service (build later, one by one). Fill paymentLinks when the Razorpay links are ready.
title: Work with me
intro: 1:1 mentorship, interview prep, portfolio building, and product advisory for people building a career in product — and teams building products. Pick a service, pay securely, book your slot, and we meet over Google Meet.
refundGuarantee: 100% money-back guarantee — if a session isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full, no questions asked.
howItWorks: Pay securely (prices shown in your local currency)
Book a time that suits you on Calendly

services.name: Ask me anything
services.short: Send one focused product, career, or interview question and get a thoughtful, specific written answer back — no call needed.

services.name: Priority DM
services.short: A short window of direct messaging with me — ask follow-ups, share a doc or draft, and get quick replies without booking a call.

services.name: Discovery Call
services.short: A short 1:1 to understand where you are, what would actually move the needle, and whether ongoing mentorship is worth it. You leave with clear next steps.

services.name: Career guidance
services.short: A focused session on your path — breaking into product, leveling up, weighing offers, or mapping your next 6–12 months. A concrete plan, not generic advice.

services.name: 1:1 Mentorship
services.short: Bring whatever you're stuck on — a product decision, stakeholders, growth, interviews — and we work through it live. Best as a recurring touchpoint.

services.name: Mock interview
services.short: A realistic PM interview in the round of your choice — product sense, execution, strategy, or estimation — plus honest, specific feedback on exactly what to fix.

services.name: Resume Review & ATS Optimization
services.short: A line-by-line review of your PM resume — positioning, impact framing, and ATS-friendly formatting — so you clear the filters and the 10-second recruiter scan. Concrete rewrites, not vague notes.

services.name: Breaking into AI + Product Management
services.short: What moving into AI product roles really involves — the skills and vocabulary that matter, how to position your background, and where the real opportunities are, from someone doing it day to day.

services.name: Interview Prep: Product Manager Roles
services.short: A structured prep plan tailored to your target companies — the rounds, the mental models, practice, and feedback — so you walk in genuinely ready, not just rehearsed.

services.name: Build Your PM Portfolio
services.short: The flagship. We build a standout PM portfolio together — the right case studies, the narrative, and a polished site that makes hiring managers take you seriously. A hands-on, high-touch deep dive.

services.name: Product consultancy
services.short: Focused help on a specific product problem — strategy, positioning, monetization, AI product direction, or a review of what you're building. Book a one-hour block, or reach out to scope something larger.

services.name: Fractional PM
services.short: Embedded, part-time product leadership for teams without a senior PM. I own a slice of your roadmap — discovery, prioritization, specs, execution — a day or two a week. Starts with a free intro call.
